The clinic lists lump and mass removal for dogs and cats. New clients must call to arrange an appointment; non-client walk-ins and emergencies are not accepted, and immediate appointments may be unavailable.
The practice lists removal of benign and malignant tumors from skin, mouth and other accessible areas, with surgical consultation by appointment.

The current surgical service explicitly lists cancerous-tumor removal and reconstructive surgery. Current medical oncology and chemotherapy are not established by the historical oncology brochure. Call to arrange a surgical consultation.

reviews.before_availability_note: In-person specialty service Monday–Friday, 8 am–6 pm, by appointment; owner appointment requests and a veterinarian referral portal are available. Seven-day urgent care does not establish daily oncology appointments.
reviews.after_availability_note: The oncology department has reopened to new consultations with high demand. Currently accepted case types are lymphoma, high-grade mast cell tumors, myeloma, histiocytic sarcoma, hemangiosarcoma, osteosarcoma and melanoma. Other diagnoses are directed to regional oncology practices. Specialty appointments are Monday–Friday, 8 am–6 pm; confirm acceptance before arranging a visit.
reviews.reviewed_facts: Current page explicitly reopens consultations with seven named diagnosis groups. Retain existing chemotherapy, ECT, targeted therapy, immunotherapy and surgery; introductory radiation wording is not local delivery proof.
